# PC-HAR01 — harness readiness against requirements, Oct18

**Conclusion:** a substantially implemented and tested development harness, with
useful hosted operational evidence; not all declared features or release/host
acceptance requirements are satisfied. No overall /10 or percentage-complete
rating is inferred. The harness supplies evidence/tools, verifies claims and
controls policy/risk/execution/audit; the LLM performs semantic assessment.
PC-LABEL02's rule-output diagnostic is not a harness-intelligence grade.

audit, not a new complete security/code review or blanket rules certification.
